note: The script asks for the hook text, a question text, one name super, a number pop, two top text lines and a place tag, so 7 graphics and the end card. The CASS logo file is not in endcards/ yet, so the end card types CASS until it is added.

mg.title: Hook text
mg.cue: Hook text on frame 1: They also want a shot. Already on screen at 0:00. Does not animate on.
mg.use: Start the clip at frame 0045 (fully on) and hold it until 00:03. Top third.

mg.title: Question text

text.main: What do you wish people understood about homelessness?

mg.cue: Question text at 00:06 for 3 s, top band: What do you wish people understood about homelessness?
mg.use: Put it on at 00:06 for 3 s in the top band, before his answer lands.

mg.title: Name super
mg.cue: Name super at 00:09 for 3 s, lower left above the captions: Nathan Smith / Chief Executive Officer, CASS.
mg.use: Put it on at 00:09 for 3 s. Move it lower left, above the captions. Type the second line Chief Executive Officer, CASS under the name.

mg.title: Number pop
mg.cue: Number pop at 00:23 for 3 s, top band, as he says it: 30 / unit emergency shelter for families.
mg.use: Start at 00:23 so the number lands on <30-unit>. Top band, over the drone shot.

mg.title: Top text
mg.cue: Top text at 00:39 for 2.5 s, top band, as he says it: They're right back on track.
mg.use: Put it on at 00:39 as he says it. Top band.

mg.title: Place tag
mg.cue: Location tag at 00:44 for 2.5 s, upper left: The Haven.
mg.use: Put it on at 00:44 over the Welcome to The Haven sign. Upper left.

mg.title: Top text
mg.cue: Top text at 00:56 for 2 s, top band, as he says it: People just need a chance.
mg.use: Put it on at 00:56 as he says it. Top band. Keep captions on.

mg.title: End card
mg.cue: End card: CASS logo, then the line For more information visit cassaz.org.
mg.src: No CASS end card or logo file is in the repo yet (endcards/index.json has no CASS entry, checked 3 Nov 2026), so CASS is typed. Line from the script's end card row (cassaz.org, the CASS end card line in the client file); colours from the CASS brand (navy #2C2B77, white).
mg.use: After the last line at 00:58. Hold it to the end. Swap in the CASS logo once it is in the repo.
